title: A Mathematical Theory of Interpretation: Rational Entropy, Spectral Readout, and Confusability as a Resource
abstract: arXiv:2608.23892v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This article presents the abridged core of \emph{A Mathematical Theory of Interpretation} (MTI), which treats interpretation as observer-relative spectral measurement under an access structure. MTI makes interpretation a method-design problem: access, query, utility, and medium determine what an observer can select, identify, communicate, or refuse. On a learning-invariant Hilbert realization, Rational Entropy measures residual uncertainty across knowledge, utility, and medium. In the finite-effective regime, we classify its zero set. Pairwise confusability is equivalent to uniform atomic collapse, while a unique utility maximum can select one atom even when other zero-cost states remain non-atomic. This reverses the usual zero-error role of confusability: agreement in at least one observer direction excludes unresolved multi-atom readings, while the joint label preserves identification. translated_title: 解释的数学理论：理性熵、谱读出与可混淆性作为一种资源
translated_abstract: 本文介绍了《解释的数学理论》（MTI）的简略核心，该理论将解释视为在访问结构下的观察者相对谱测量。MTI将解释转化为一个方法设计问题：访问、查询、效用和媒介决定了观察者能够选择、识别、交流或拒绝的内容。在基于学习不变性的希尔伯特实现中，理性熵衡量了知识、效用和媒介之间的残余不确定性。在有限有效机制下，我们对其零集进行了分类。成对可混淆性等价于均匀原子坍缩，而独特的效用最大值可以在其他零成本状态保持非原子时选择单个原子。这逆转了可混淆性在零误差中的通常作用：在至少一个观察者方向上的一致性排除了未解决的多原子读数，而联合标签保持了识别性。相应的自由设计容量是预...
tldr: 本文提出了一种将解释视为观察者相对谱测量的数学理论，通过理性熵和可混淆性分析，揭示了效用最大化可克服混淆性以实现唯一识别的机制。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a mathematical theory treating interpretation as observer-relative spectral measurement, showing that utility maximization can overcome confusability to achieve unique identification via rational entropy analysis.
